item.title: As Stardew Valley turns ten, ConcernedApe's life game still holds a personally important record
item.description: I firmly believe Stardew Valley’s multiplayer update was the most important of the last decade, because its magic is well worth sharing.

item.title: A decade on, beloved dark-fantasy ARPG Grim Dawn prepares for its "final hurrah," and it's an absolutely massive one
item.description: The Grim Dawn Fangs of Asterkarn expansion “is in its final stretch,” and developer Crate Entertainment is staggered by its popularity.

item.title: Scientists get Doom running on chips powered by 200,000 human neurons, and those clever little cells are playing it too
item.description: Using the age-old medium of Doom, boffins just gave us a look into our cyborg future by making the game run on wetware computers.

item.title: Best gaming headset 2026
item.description: Our top gaming headsets span a range of budgets with wireless, wired, Bluetooth, and surround options from brands like Corsair and Logitech.

item.title: Highguard's new Raid Rush mode nips the looting phase in the bud, and it could be enough to turn its fortunes around
item.description: If the slow and steady start to each match ruined multiplayer FPS game Highguard for you, its new Raid Rush mode might be the answer.

item.title: A new Space Marine 2 update just added a free class, weapon, and map, but you'll have to pay for its cool new voice lines
item.description: The new Space Marine 2 Techmarine class comes with a powerful melee weapon, bringing increased carnage to the co-op third-person shooter.

item.title: Terraria teases "very exciting potential" for builders after celebrating one of its "largest player spikes" yet

item.description: Path Of Exile Mirage lets you interact with many core mechanics in new ways, and the Atlas map has been redesigned for PoE 3.28 and beyond.

item.description: During this week's Triple Click podcast, decorated games guy Jason Schreier explains why Sony might keep its exclusives off PC once again.
